description: Returns which FX trading sessions are currently open (Sydney, Tokyo, London, New York) and when the next session opens or closes, for questions such as 'is the market open?', 'when does London open?', or 'which sessions overlap right now?'. An ISO-8601 UTC timestamp in `at` returns the snapshot for a specific moment instead of now. Accounts for weekends and major banking holidays. Access: free, no API key required.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; defaults to now. Use to snapshot session state at a specific moment.

name: market_sessions
title: FX Market Sessions
